name: mobile
comment:scripts: `dev` now starts the dev-client bundler, not Expo Go. @maplibre/maplibre-react-native contains native code and Expo Go ships a fixed set of native modules, so it cannot load it — scanning the QR code with Expo Go now fails at the point the map screen renders. Run `ios` or `android` once to produce a development build; after that `dev` attaches to it.
comment:ferrostar: The two @stadiamaps/ferrostar-* packages are not on npm yet (stadiamaps/ferrostar#961). They are built from Ferrostar's 0.57.0 tag by .github/scripts/build-ferrostar.sh and installed from this repository's `ferrostar-rn-0.57.0` release; the lockfile's integrity hash pins their contents. The build lists core's need for the bindings as a peer rather than a dependency, so this app supplies it: pnpm refuses a dependency's own dependency from a URL, and turning that protection off for the workspace is the wrong price. When Stadia publishes them, name the registry versions here (`monorepo-structure`).
